ms.text:
MP1
variable chosen
valid variable which may affect t
MP2
additional apparatus
stop-watch / timer
and
additional apparatus (if needed) to measure the
independent variable
MP3
method
(hold ball and release and) measure time between the
(two) marks / lines or measure t
and
repeat for new value of independent variable
MP4
control variables
any significant variable appropriate to the independent
variable

MP5
results table
columns, quantities with correct units, for independent
variable and dependent variable
MP6
conclusion
compare readings in the table to see if / how / whether a
change in the variable produces a change in t
OR
plot a (line) graph with axes specified
MP7
additional point (one from):
second valid control variable stated
at least 5 sets of data taken
repeat each measurement (of time) and take an
average
